models.name: pl
models.description: absorbed power law, 2-10 keV (continuum null hypothesis)

models.name: pl_line_narrow
models.description: narrow Fe K-alpha, sigma fixed at 50 eV (rest 6.4 keV)

models.name: pl_line_broad
models.description: broad Fe K-alpha, sigma fixed at 300 eV (the degenerate competitor of pcfabs); a free width is a flat likelihood direction and did not converge

models.name: pcfabs
models.description: partial covering absorber: the degenerate competitor of a broad line

notes: REAL DATA: the XMM-Newton EPIC PPS spectra of PDS 456 that already back the xmm_xspec product.

pl and pl_line_narrow converged.  pl_line_broad, pcfabs and warmabs were stopped: the C-stat peak is flat along the line normalisation, driving the sampler to ~0.02 % efficiency at 75-95 % of the volume, so their evidences are not quoted rather than being given a non-converged value.
Band is 2-10 keV: with 0.5 keV included an unmodelled soft excess holds chi2/dof at 2.70 and no Bayes factor is interpretable.
Result on real data: d ln Z(pl_line_narrow - pl) < 0, i.e. no Bayesian evidence for a 50 eV Fe K-alpha line, even though it improves chi2 by 27.3.
